name: fitglue-web
description: FitGlue web frontend and Firebase Hosting configuration

scripts.build: npm run _build:app && npm run _flatten && BUILD_ENV=prod npm run _build:static
scripts.build:dev: vite build --mode development && npm run _flatten && BUILD_ENV=dev npm run _build:static
scripts.serve: npm run build:dev && npx firebase serve --only hosting
scripts.serve:prod: npm run build:prod && npx firebase serve --only hosting -P prod
scripts._flatten: sh -c 'if [ -d dist/public ]; then cp -r dist/public/* dist/ && rm -rf dist/public; fi'
scripts.gen-api: npx openapi-typescript ../server/docs/api/gateway/client.openapi.yaml -o src/shared/api/schema-client.ts && npx openapi-typescript ../server/docs/api/gateway/admin.openapi.yaml -o src/shared/api/schema-admin.ts && npx openapi-typescript ../server/docs/api/gateway/public.openapi.yaml -o src/shared/api/schema-public.ts
scripts.preflight:
echo '
========== PREFLIGHT: Web ==========' && echo '
[1/5] Proto sync check...' && npm run check-proto-sync && echo '
[2/5] Type checking...' && tsc --noEmit && echo '
[3/5] Linting...' && npm run lint && echo '
[4/5] Tests + coverage...' && npm run test:coverage && echo '
[5/5] Building...' && npm run build && echo '
========== ✅ Web preflight passed =========='

author: James King
